subject.title: fix(copilot): bound BYOK proxy request bodies

question: Should Copilot BYOK enforce the proposed 16 MiB body limit and 30-second upload timeout while exposing caller-owned teardown through the shared plugin SDK helper?
rationale: Source and synthetic loopback proof establish the resource-exhaustion fix, but they do not define the maximum legitimate Copilot SDK request envelope or independently authorize a new public plugin SDK option.

options.title: Calibrate and retain bounds
options.body: Validate representative Copilot SDK requests, including tool- and attachment-heavy payloads, then keep or adjust the constants and focused tests accordingly.

options.title: Accept the proposed envelope
options.body: Explicitly own the possibility that unusually large or slow existing BYOK requests will begin returning 413 or 408.

options.title: Pause for another boundary
options.body: Hold the PR if Copilot SDK traffic cannot be bounded safely at this proxy layer without a documented SDK-derived envelope.

recommendation.title: Calibrate and retain bounds
recommendation.body: Validate representative Copilot SDK requests, including tool- and attachment-heavy payloads, then keep or adjust the constants and focused tests accordingly.

likelyOwner.reason: The merged feature history ties this person most directly to the original Copilot BYOK proxy contract and its expected request shapes.
